name: Infected Towns
detailed_description:
PROCEDURALLY GENERATED OPEN WORLD

The game takes place in a procedurally generated open world, with different towns, point of interests, rural areas, unique places. All the places are fully explorable and lootable, with each one presenting his own surprises and challenges.

REALISTIC HARDCORE SURVIVAL MECHANICS

The gameplay focus on realistic hardcore survival mechanics, from health management, temperature, food, loot, farming, fishing, and fighting zombies or other survivors.

SKILLS & CRAFTING

The game features a long list of skills you'll need to improve to survive. From physical skills, to shooting, carpentry, foraging, and much more.

Find materials by looting buildings, and craft your own equipment, furniture, and base.

ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS

The game will be playable both in singleplayer mode, coop and multiplayer.

IN-DEPTH CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION

You can customize your character, from the clothes, equipment, hair, body, height, tattoos... But also his former occupation, skills, and much more.
